name: town-noon
prompt: Change only the time of day and what the tiny vehicles and people are doing. It is early afternoon under a high warm sun with short shadows and a clear deep-blue sky. The white delivery van is now parked beside the community kitchen with the blue awning at the back, its rear doors open, and tiny volunteers carry brown cartons from the van to the kitchen's table, where a short queue of people waits with plates. The small blue truck is now parked at the godown's gate, and the two workers at the table unload its cartons. The highway is empty. Keep everything exactly as it is: the same camera and framing, the same composition, every building, road, tree, fence and the thin softly glowing green painted path in the same place with the same shape, size and colours. No lettering anywhere, no words or numbers on any sign, no logos.
postprocess: WebP q82; the PNG original stays local in src/
use: smartclearance.com's hero (SC-111): one hour of the journey's day, a plate of the film and, for the morning and the night, its poster in each theme
